name: Hoshikuzu Heliograph
source:
‘This is my first _____, after all.’

There’s a famous island from which you can see a comet that makes wishes come true once every few decades——Hoshinami island.

You are a third-year high school student who was born and raised on this island surrounded by the emerald green sea. With your childhood friends Subaru and Nachi, and your neighbour Syouma, you form a photography club and so, your everyday life is filled with happiness. 

But graduation day is right around the corner. 

One day, around six months before graduation, a transfer student arrives at your high school in the middle of the semester. 
At the same time, an older childhood friend of yours, who left the island, comes back as a teacher…

The things you’ve always taken for granted will no longer be treated as such.

When you realise this, something stirs inside your chest as if it were announcing that something was about to change.

What might be the unique feeling you will find on a southern island surrounded by the sea and the stars?

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
translation:
“毕竟，这是我的第一次 _____。”

有一座著名的岛屿，在那里你可以看到每隔几十年就能实现一次愿望的彗星——星波岛。

你是一名高中三年级的学生，在这座被翠绿大海包围的小岛上出生和长大。你们和儿时好友昴、那智，以及邻居翔马组成了摄影社，每天的生活都充满了幸福。

但毕业的日子即将来临。

有一天，大约在毕业前六个月，一名转学生在学期中期抵达你的高中。
与此同时，你的一位年长的儿时朋友离开了岛屿，以老师的身份回来了……

你一直认为理所当然的事情将不再被视为理所当然。

当你意识到这一点时，你的胸口里有什么东西在搅动，仿佛在宣布某些事情即将发生变化。

在被大海和星星包围的南方岛屿上，你会发现什么独特的感觉？

[翻译自[url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]官方网站[/url]。]
